text: So you can tell what each new thing does, add them one at a time, starting with the UMP trial and working down the list below to the keto diet. 5-HTP could help your mood here, though iboga acts on serotonin too, so don't take 5-HTP at all while you're microdosing iboga or elliptica. But if you want UMP with any microdose, or 5-HTP with a mushroom microdose, there isn't enough data yet to say whether the warnings against taking these supplements on psychedelic days apply to microdose days. Until there's more data, you can try the one you want on a microdose day, then again on a day you skip the microdose, to see which day feels better. If you're too numb to tell, compare your sleep and dreams on the nights after each kind of day. Like iboga, mushrooms act on serotonin, so stop the 5-HTP if you get any of the stop signs the 5-HTP section lists.
section: Weeks 3–5: The Dynorphin Void (Depression Phase), a new first line
reader: someone with trauma in the numb, gray phase of weeks 3 to 5 (the "Void"), about to start its UMP and 5-HTP trials, an iboga, elliptica or mushroom microdose and the keto diet, who needs to know in what order, and whether UMP or 5-HTP can go with a microdose day

sentences.payoff: they learn that for UMP with a microdose, or 5-HTP with a mushroom microdose, nobody can say yet whether the psychedelic-day warnings apply, so a microdose day is neither ruled out nor cleared
sentences.follows: it turns from the one settled pairing to the ones that are not

sentences.s: Until there's more data, you can try the one you want on a microdose day, then again on a day you skip the microdose, to see which day feels better.

sentences.follows: it answers the unknown the sentence before states

checked.found: psilocybin's active form, psilocin, is an agonist at many serotonin receptors, mainly 5-HT2A (Ling et al. 2022, CNS Drugs, PMID 34791625)
checked.still_needed: yes: they learn why 5-HTP with mushrooms needs watching, so they stop it at its stop signs

same_point: read the section from its heading (Weeks 3–5) to the next (Week 8+) for one-at-a-time and for UMP or 5-HTP with psychedelics. The 5-HTP line's "Do not use with ... iboga" says S2's no; S2 keeps it because his answer 17 gives it as the one microdose exception, and a reader who thinks a microdose doesn't count would miss it; that line stays for its other items. The UMP line's "Do not take UMP on psychedelic days" and the 5-HTP line's "same-day psychedelics" are the warnings S3 points to, kept where they are. No other paragraph of the section gives the order or the microdose rule
